summary: Added .pmcro/policies/resource-operations.json (allow/approval/deny per resource per verb, defaulting unknown resources to deny), .pmcro/scripts/resource_ops.py (generic engine, exit codes 0/1/2/3/4/5 where 5 is an explicit not-implemented escalation rather than a silent stub), and three skills: pmcro-resource as the generic core with pmcro-laws and pmcro-frames as thin wrappers routing by name. Added plugins/pmcro/agents/laws-operator.agent.md as the smallest end-to-end path. Added .pmcro/scripts/checkpoint.py (claims with heartbeats, atomic writes, corrupt-file recovery, unreleased claims retained as abandoned) and two editor hooks: .claude/scripts/control_plane_guard.py enforcing the same policy table against Write and Edit, and .claude/scripts/checkpoint_beat.py recording a heartbeat after each write. Created the archive-pattern folders under .pmcro. Version research for the .NET stage recorded: MAF 1.21.0 stable with hosting at 1.21.0-preview.260911.1, Aspire 13.5.3 pinned as a whole family per the archive's MethodAccessException lesson, ModelContextProtocol 2.2.0, SDKs 10.0.401 and 11.0.100-preview.7.
